entries.zh: 辱罵；以惡言責罵使人羞愧
entries.en: to revile; to put someone to shame with abuse
entries.notes: L欄末尾作coßig，拼寫殘損；義依H「阻罵」與M「chò ìnē」推定為責罵羞辱。

entries.zh: 有負於人；失禮於人而慚愧
entries.en: to fail someone; to fall into fault and feel ashamed
entries.notes: R欄jit xīn與M欄sít làng對音不諧，義依L「caer en falta」及H「失人」推定。

entries.en: to make someone feel embarrassed; to shame another person
entries.notes: L欄殘損（otro van &c）；M「bô i sü」當即「無意思」，義取使人難堪。

entries.en: to be ashamed (sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L欄殘損、H欄標[疑]，M/R僅存音讀，無法確定具體義項。

entries.zh: 當衆使人蒙羞；公然羞辱
entries.en: to put someone to shame in front of others
entries.notes: H欄「翕衆」標[疑:歙衆]，字形未定；義依L「delante de otros」推定。

entries.en: to shame; to put to shame
entries.notes: L欄「fuanda」拼寫殘損，H欄標[疑:盖]，義從「羞」字。

entries.en: to be ashamed; to look ashamed
to feel shame; to be ashamed
to be ashamed; to feel shame
to be humiliated; to suffer disgrace
to be ashamed; to fail in courtesy
entries.notes: M欄混入西語ja vergonça，R欄音節殘缺；義依H「失接」之失禮義推得，存疑。

entries.en: to be disgraced; to be defiled and shamed
to be ashamed (text uncertain)
entries.notes: H欄「八妬」標[疑:姖]，與M「pè ty」、R「pā jù」對音不合，僅能依L定為羞愧義。

entries.zh: 自覺卑微而慚愧；靦腆退縮
entries.en: to be ashamed of oneself; to feel abashed
entries.notes: L「por leuitar」當作levantarse；H欄標[疑:畏鄙]，義從「畏鄙」推得。

entries.en: to investigate; to inquire into; to examine
entries.notes: L欄並列averiguar/hurgar/examinar/preguntar四義；R欄cō hēo與H「豁」音讀不諧，未能互證。

entries.en: to decide clearly; to adjudicate after inquiry
to interrogate; to examine judicially
to interrogate and examine; to try
to investigate; to trace to the source
to investigate thoroughly; to get to the bottom of
to determine by judging; to adjudicate
to cross-examine; to interrogate closely
to inquire about a matter; to ask questions
to investigate by visiting; to inspect
to interrogate during an inspection; to inquire on a visit
entries.notes: L欄「pregado」拼寫可疑（或為preguntado），義依H「勘問」與visita語境推定。
